nodes.text: Synthetic State K DOI Rule CLM-2026-04, effective 2026-04-01: payment is due 15 calendar days after complete proof of loss for an accepted claim.
Claim CLM-2214 recorded complete proof of loss at 2026-06-03T12:00:00Z and accepted coverage at 2026-06-04T09:00:00Z.
Payment service calculates due_at as complete_proof_of_loss_at plus 15 calendar days using rule CLM-2026-04. It emits a deadline alert at 5 days and a supervisor escalation at due_at.
Control test for CLM-2214 recomputed the 2026-06-18 due date from the proof event and retained the alert and payment timestamps.
Synthetic State N Claims Rule N-2026-09, version 1.0 effective 2026-01-01: payment is due within 20 business days after the proof-of-loss package is marked complete.
Workflow v7 requires the completion event before payment approval, invokes the business-day calendar, and routes an overdue item to Claims Compliance.
Claim records include proof_package_complete_at and payment_due_at. The scheduler stores rule N-2026-09, sends alerts, and writes an immutable delivery log.
Quarterly test evidence shows a simulated complete package produced a due date 20 business days later and an overdue escalation when payment was withheld.
